name: Memphis Design
summary: Clashing primary and pastel fields, squiggles, confetti dots and black-and-white pattern on irregular geometric forms. Ettore Sottsass and the Memphis group launched it in Milan in 1981 as a joke against good taste.

philosophy.core_thesis: Good taste is a convention, and a loud, cheap, playful object can carry as much meaning as a serious one.
design_principles: Combine at least four saturated hues on one surface, and put no two neighbouring fields in the same hue.
Build every composition from primitive shapes: circles, triangles, half-circles, arches and 45 degree bars at sizes between 24px and 320px.
Cover one or two large areas with a repeating black-and-white pattern such as stripes of 8px, dots of 6px at 16px pitch, or a zigzag.
Scatter 6 to 20 small accents (squiggles, confetti dots, short bars) over the empty ground, and rotate each by an angle between -30 and 30 degrees.
Set the display type in a heavy geometric sans, and let one word break the baseline or tilt by 5 to 12 degrees.
Give shapes hard 3px black outlines and hard offset shadows with no blur.
Place blocks off axis and overlap them by 10% to 30%, so that no edge lines up with the page edge.
anti_patterns: A single accent colour on a white page
Soft gradients, blur and realistic shadows
Strict centred or modular grids with equal margins
Muted earth tones and desaturated greys as the main palette
Symmetrical layouts with one shape repeated at one size
Photographic backgrounds behind the pattern layer

layout.grid_mechanics: No fixed grid; compose on a loose 8px unit with 5 to 9 blocks per screen, each rotated between -15 and 15 degrees or shifted off the column axis by 16px to 64px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: Only 10% to 25% of the surface stays plain; the rest holds shapes and pattern, and the spacing scale is 8, 24, 40, 72px.
layout.alignment_rules: Mix flush-left, flush-right and tilted text blocks on one page; align to the shape edge, not to a margin, and overlap blocks by 10% to 30%.
layout.container_geometry: Irregular shapes: arches, half-circles, trapezoids and rectangles with one 48px rounded corner; every container has a 3px black outline and a 6px hard offset shadow.

font_pairings.note: Heavy blocky capitals over a plain geometric text face.
Signage-like display type with a neutral body.
A single geometric family used at weights 800 and 400.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take 0em to +0.02em in upper case; body stays at 0; small labels take +0.08em.
typography.leading: Display 0.95 to 1.05; body 1.4 to 1.5; tilted lines keep the same value.
hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 and 800 only, with a size jump of 3x or more between body and headline.
Set headlines in upper case, 64px to 160px, and rotate one of them by 5 to 12 degrees.
Put a headline on a solid colour block with a 3px black outline for contrast, not on the pattern.
Keep body copy under 60 characters per line, in black on a flat light field.

color.palette_structure: Five to six saturated hues in near equal shares, plus black and white pattern; no hue covers more than 30% of the surface.
color.contrast_rules: Body text is black on white, yellow or sky at 12:1 or better; coloured fields touch each other only across a 3px black outline.
color.surface_treatment: Flat opaque fields in the manner of plastic laminate, overprinted with black-and-white pattern at 100% opacity; no gradients and no transparency.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source; depth comes from a hard 6px by 6px offset shadow in ink with 0px blur, and from overlap order.

materiality.surface_simulation: Plastic laminate such as Abet Laminati Bacterio and Diffrazioni patterns, rendered as flat colour with no gloss.
materiality.border_rules: Solid black outlines of 3px on every shape; patterned bands of 8px to 16px may replace a border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; elevation is a single level with a 6px by 6px hard shadow, which grows to 10px by 10px on hover.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Chunky shapes with a 3px black outline and solid fills in two hues, square or fully round terminals, no perspective.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Collages of primitive shapes, squiggles and terrazzo speckle; figures reduce to circles and bars; no photographs.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: shapes snap in a few discrete steps and wobble by 3 to 5 degrees, like cut paper pinned to a board; no smooth blur or fade.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover moves the block by 4px up and left and grows the offset shadow to 10px; active returns it to 0px and rotates it by 2 degrees.

emotion.target_response: Delight and mild provocation: the viewer feels that the rules are off for a moment and that the object is a joke worth keeping.

avoid_when: The product handles money, health or legal tasks that need a calm tone.
The text is long and needs steady reading.
The page must meet a strict accessibility audit with limited motion and pattern.

modifiers.how: Cut the palette to black, white and one hue, align blocks to a 12-column grid and remove the pattern; keep one tilted headline.
Replace the shapes with flat figures, drop the black outlines and hard shadows, and keep the saturated hues and the off-axis blocks.
Add a 1px inner highlight and a 12px soft shadow to each block; keep the hues and the primitive shapes.

pack.why: Bold forms with a hard offset tone: the flat pop geometry of the laminate.
